task_description: Build the complete Kartiva storefront UI: shared components (Navbar, Footer, CartProvider, skeletons), core pages (Home, Shop, Product detail, Cart, Checkout), auth pages (Login, Register, Reset, Update-password), account/dashboard pages (Profile, Addresses, Orders, Order detail, Notifications), and the invoice download API route. Premium-minimal brand, mobile-first, Tailwind v4, @base-ui/react components, server actions as data layer.
